name: Science Requirements and Detector Concepts for the Electron-Ion Collider: EIC Yellow Report
notes: doc_type physics_paper is the closest available type: the abstract calls it a report on the physics case, detector requirements and detector concepts, not a conceptual design report.

summary.plain: The EIC User Group's 2021 report on the physics case for the Electron-Ion Collider and the detector requirements and concepts that led to the ePIC detector.
summary.technical: Three-volume report (executive summary; physics measurements and detector requirements; general-purpose detector concepts and technologies) commissioned and organised by the EIC User Group; it argues the case for two complementary detectors and interaction regions.
